dedup: Compared DOI, arXiv, merged aliases and normalized titles across all tracked historical evidence, including compressed files and early catalogue. Compared first-author surname and similar titles in earlier bibliographies. Any earlier substantive or incidental mention is conservatively treated as historical.
family_handling: The conference and journal versions of the coating-thickness study were collapsed under the journal DOI. Both have the same author pair; the Zaki–Nassar conference authorship and Nassar–Zaki journal authorship have reversed order.
The RBO and telesurgery preprints are represented under their journal articles; the AURSAD arXiv paper and datasets have distinct identities.
The two tilted-plate metrology papers are different publications. The 2018 preliminary study explicitly omits Mz.
Data-article inclusion does not add a second copy of an independently audited dataset.
limitations: Purposive public search with publisher and index rate limits. A task-quality label, tightening torque, calculated wrench or fitted preload is not automatically an independent force measurement. No raw datasets or full papers redistributed by this literature catalogue.
